summary: Adds a required boolean field marketing_opt_in to the account_user table using an expand stage that adds the column with NOT NULL and default false, ensuring no NULL rows; the new version is deployed with a state‑only migration, and the old version is retired after the new version takes over.
write_consistency: Old version inserts rely on the column's DEFAULT false, so no NULL appears; new version explicitly sets the field; both versions read/write the same row with consistent false default during overlap.

stages.description: Add NOT NULL boolean column marketing_opt_in with default false to account_user table.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN marketing_opt_in boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

stages.description: Retire the old Saleor version after the new version is serving traffic.
